title: Combined compilation plan can assign one direct effect to both a dedicated stream and a base continuation

source_observation.environment: Reporter mod-list custody SHA-256 E5C99BD9A7C0B28F061C2D6F0F50371ACE3508A447805921183C605F56E65AC4; exact Factorio 2.1.13 and 2.0.77 reproductions against immutable 3.2.5 and 2.5.5 packages with portal-verified Space Exploration closures.
source_observation.fact: Space Exploration copies laser gun-speed effects to the Tesla ammo category. MIR then planned that identity in both its dedicated electric-shooting-speed stream and the generated weapon-shooting-speed base continuation, causing the strict combined-plan duplicate validator to abort package loading.

reproducer.command: Run immutable 3.2.5 or 2.5.5 with the exact portal-locked Space Exploration closure and create a save through a dedicated userdata root.
reproducer.expected: One deterministic owner supplies type=gun-speed;ammo_category=tesla and the final duplicate validator remains strict.
reproducer.observed: Immutable 3.2.5 and 2.5.5 abort with CompilationPlan contains duplicate direct-effect identity: type=gun-speed;ammo_category=tesla.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: No technology or migration identity changes. The combined plan removes only the losing effect claim, refreshes a partially retained base continuation's TechnologyDesign and fingerprints, and omits an emptied base continuation.
